name: Tensou Sentai Goseiger
description: The alien invasion force called Warstar destroy the Heaven’s Tower, the bridge between the Earth and the Gosei World, home of the Gosei Angels. Five apprentice Gosei Angels who happened to be on the Earth transform into Goseiger and fight to defend the Earth.

videos.title: DX Datas Hyper & Gosei Mic CM
DX Datas Hyper, Hyper Gosei Great & Gosei Mic CM
DX Datas Hyper, Hyper Gosei Great & Mystic Brothers Set CM
DX Gosei Ground & Ground Gosei Great CM
Epic 1: The Gosei Angels Descend
videos.overview: A boy named Nozomu encounters Alata, a Gosei Angel in training who tries to help give him confidence even as he and his four teammates face the onslaught of the invaders of Warstar.

videos.title: Epic 2: Fantastic Goseigers
videos.overview: Hyde tries to take advantage of a rare opportunity to return to Gosei World even as Nozomu and other humans become abducted by another Warstar Insect Monster.

videos.title: Epic 3: Landick Power, Divided
videos.overview: Moune desperately tries to prove herself to her older brother Agri, even as it leads to trouble for the Landicks against a freezing Warstar Insect.

videos.title: Epic 4: Echo, Song of the Angels
videos.overview: A musical Warstar Insect disables the Skyick duo with its noise, even as Eri may have the key to stopping its destructive concert.

videos.title: Epic 5: Magical Hyde
videos.overview: The analytic Hyde and the impatient Agri help a doctor try to find the cure to a Warstar Insect malady changing kids into Bibi Soldiers.

videos.title: Epic 6: Breakout Goseigers
videos.overview: Alata tries to learn a gymnastic move to prove to Nozomu he can do it too even as Dereputa begins targeting him once again.

videos.title: Epic 7: Protect the Land!
videos.overview: After losing Eri in a bet, Agri is forced to work for an old farmer in order to get her back from him.

videos.title: Epic 8: Gosei Power, Out of Control
videos.overview: The bizarre ability of a Warstar Insect makes Alata lose complete control of his invocation abilities, making his Gosei Cards become unpredictable!

videos.title: Epic 9: Gotcha☆Gosei Girls
videos.overview: The incompatible Eri and Moune are stuck working together to save the male Goseiger after they become captured by a dominating female Warstar Insect.

videos.title: Epic 10: Hyde's Partner
videos.overview: When the enemy who killed his partner re-emerges, Hyde decides to pursue him at the cost of losing the concept of what he is fighting for as a Goseiger.

videos.title: Epic 11: Spark, Landick Power
videos.overview: Moune's desire to support a girl undergoing surgery is threatened when a Warstar Insect steals the electricity from the hospital, forcing her and Datas to use a unique method to overcome this.

videos.title: Epic 12: The Miraculous Gosei Headder Great Assembly
videos.overview: When the Goseiger become too worked up when both Mons Drake and Dereputa come down to destroy Earth, Master Head pulls them away to force them to discover what is on their side.

videos.title: Epic 13: Run! The Mystic Runner
videos.overview: When Eri discovers a Skick ability only Alata knows, she undertakes a surprising training regiment in order to learn how to do it.

videos.title: Epic 14: Birth of the Ultimate Tag!
videos.overview: Moune and Hyde must put aside their differences when they become trapped within a powerful Warstar Insect's dimensional gate with no apparent means of escape.

videos.title: Epic 15: Countdown! The Life of the Earth
videos.overview: When Mons Drake performs a final act which gives the Earth 24 hours before its end, the Goseiger must confront the leader of Warstar to save their planet before Earth is destroyed!

videos.title: Epic 16: Dynamic Alata
videos.overview: As the Goseiger celebrate the end of Warstar, a powerful enemy returns to destroy the team and to finish off his greatest rival: Alata!

videos.title: Epic 17: A New Enemy! The Yuumajuu
videos.overview: A foreboding discovery and the mysterious deaths of famous celebrities force the Goseiger to face a powerful, ancient opponent, while gaining unexpected assistance from a mysterious warrior who once fought them!

videos.title: Epic 18: The Earth Purifying Knight of Destiny
videos.overview: The Goseiger try to understand Gosei Knight and his desire to destroy human society for its ills as a propeganda-spewing Yuumajuu takes over the airwaves.

videos.title: Epic 19: Gosei Knight Will Not Allow It
videos.overview: Agri feels sorry for himself when he lets a family become separated by a Yuumajuu working with Buredoran to manipulate Gosei Knight's power for themselves.

videos.title: Epic 20: Fall In Love Goseigers
videos.overview: The Goseiger take on a challenge to help a boy get a girl to go out with him as a Yuumajuu uses its power to ruin lovers.

videos.title: Epic 21: Elegant Eri
videos.overview: When a baker is hurt during a Yuumajuu attack, Eri takes over the shop to make a particular cake for a special customer.

videos.title: Epic 22: Over the Rainbow
videos.overview: When the Yuumajuu who sealed away Gosei Knight 10,000 years ago returns, the rogue Headder tries to handle the battle on his own while continuing to see the modern Goseiger in his way.

videos.title: Epic 23: Burn! Goseigers
videos.overview: The male Goseiger must come to the rescue of the females and the Amachi when a Yuumajuu makes them overheat on vacation in a plot to burn Earth.

videos.title: Epic 24: Miracle Attack Goseigers
videos.overview: The Goseiger try to prevent Buredoran from obtaining an ancient Gosei power known for its destructive potential but remaining untamed.

videos.title: Epic 25: Nostalgic Moune
videos.overview: Moune lets her guard down when a Yuumajuu takes the form of her mother in order to lure her away from the other Goseiger.

videos.title: Epic 26: The Laughing Gosei Angels
videos.overview: Hyde and Gosei Knight become an unlikely combo who must save the other Goseiger from a Yuumajuu who captures anyone who laughs.

videos.title: Epic 27: Wake Up Agri!
videos.overview: A Yuumajuu exposes Agri's insecurities making him believe that the other Goseiger find him worthless to their team.

videos.title: Epic 28: A Father's Treasure
videos.overview: Professor Amachi worries about the welfare of Nozomu after a Yuumajuu hypnotizes him into becoming one of its emotionless servants.

videos.title: Epic 29: The Goseigers are Sealed!
videos.overview: Buredoran gains access to the Yuumajuu's Erurei Box in order to seal the Goseiger's Miracle Headders, but also to prepare for even bigger ambitions.

videos.title: Epic 30: Romantic Eri
videos.overview: Eri becomes trapped within a dream-stealing Yuumajuu where she becomes the only hope of those who have lost their way.

videos.title: Epic 31: Never Give Up, Goseigers!
videos.overview: Makuin merges his power with the Erurei Box, creating an indestructible platoon that can only be defeated if the Goseiger can stop him!

videos.title: Epic 32: Perform the Ultimate Miracle!
videos.overview: Kingong releases the final phase of the Yuumajuu's ultimate plot, forcing the Goseiger to enter into a risky scenario in order to stop their plan once and for all!

videos.title: Epic 33: The Dreadful Matrintis Empire
videos.overview: Nozomu inquires the Goseiger about their current status after the fall of the Yuumajuu while a new enemy uses their research of the Goseiger to start their own invasion schemes.

videos.title: Epic 34: Gosei Knight Justice
videos.overview: Nozomu makes GoseiKnight question his purpose in order to convince him to help the Goseiger face down the Matrintis forces.

videos.title: Epic 35: Find the Perfect Leader!
videos.overview: When a Matroid criticizes the Goseigers' lack of hierarchy, they decide to figure out which of them should be the leader of their team.

videos.title: Epic 36: Run, Agri!
videos.overview: Agri undergoes special training in order to protect a runner from a Matrintis plot to turn athletes into mecha-humans.

videos.title: Epic 37: Excited Moune
videos.overview: Moune must find a way to keep her calm after she obtains a brace from a Matroid which will petrify her if she gets too emotional.

videos.title: Epic 38: Alice vs. Gosei Knight
videos.overview: Gosei Knight tries to comprehend the importance of connections as Metal Alice goes on a rampage to destroy human society the Goseiger must put a stop to.

videos.title: Epic 39: Epic Zero
videos.overview: A time-controlling Matroid and a familiar opponent leads to a battle where Alata is thrown back to before the destruction of Heaven's Tower and the formation of the Goseiger team!

videos.title: Epic 40: Strong Alata
videos.overview: While the Goseigers deal with an onslaught from Robogog in the present, Alata must unite the three tribes to show their common bond to defeat Bakutofūji-ER in the past.

videos.title: Epic 41: Exploding Bonds of Friendship!
videos.overview: Eri takes in an abandoned Matroid which she tries to teach the concepts of friendship to, even with Metal Alice's true purpose for it.

videos.title: Epic 42: Passionate Hyde
videos.overview: Datas is abducted by Metal Alice for further Matrintis study, pushing Hyde into trying to get him back.

videos.title: Epic 43: The Empire's General Attack
videos.overview: When Robogog announces his final campaign for conquering Earth, the Goseiger respond in facing Matrintis' forces, even with the unexpected moves and sacrifices needed to do so!

videos.title: Epic 44: The Ultimate Final Battle
videos.overview: The Goseiger launch a final assault on Robogog to prevent Matrintis from conquering Earth; but the confrontation leads to a final twist and an unexpected conclusion!

videos.title: Epic 45: The Messiah is Born
videos.overview: The Goseiger go over all their known knowledge of Buredoran in order to figure out who he really is as he prepares to begin his own ultimate plans for conquering Earth.

videos.title: Epic 46: Gosei Knight is Targeted
videos.overview: Brajira targets his former Headder Gosei Knight in order to force him to work for him again; while Agri and Moune must use their siblings abilities to defeat a threat that keeps healing itself.

videos.title: Epic 47: The Trap of the Earth Salvation Plan
videos.overview: Hyde takes offense at Brajira treating his Headders, including the now brainwashed Gosei Knight, as tools instead of as partners to work together with.

videos.title: Epic 48: The Fighting Gosei Power
videos.overview: As Eri takes care of Nozomu, Alata and the other Goseiger try to handle Dark Gosei Knight, believing that he is the final key required for Brajira's Nega-End ceremony.

videos.title: Epic 49: Fight Towards the Future
videos.overview: Brajira begins the ceremony for his ultimate destruction and recreation of Earth, forcing the Goseiger to face him in one final showdown to prevent everything they protect from being lost.

videos.title: Epic 50: Protecting the Planet is an Angel's Duty
videos.overview: The Goseiger fight to prevent Brajira's final destruction of Earth in order to finish their apprenticeship and prove themselves as true guardian Gosei Angels protecting the planet and all life upon it.
